inside.title: Post steps, extensions and toolsets.
inside.line: MeshForge is the workshop. These plug into it, and agents can drive every one of them.

items.name: Edit in Blender
items.line: A post step. Opens the mesh in Blender in the middle of the chain; one click sends it back with its materials slot for slot, as a new version. Skinned garments keep their skeleton, weights and morphs.

items.name: Meshy retexture
items.line: A post step. A new surface on the same geometry from a description, one picture or up to four, at 2K, 4K or 8K. Works on any mesh, yours included.

items.name: Tripo retexture
items.line: A post step. Re-textures from the model itself, a style prompt or pictures, with PBR and baked lighting removed. Works on any mesh.

items.name: Lux3D retopology
items.line: A post step. Rebuilds a mesh to a face budget in quads or triangles, and can bake base colour, metallic and roughness onto the new one. Works on any mesh.

items.name: Lux3D material transfer
items.line: A post step. Repaints a mesh from a picture. Works on any mesh.

items.name: Sculpt in the editor
items.line: A post step. Sculpt, smooth, lattice and bend or twist a working copy inside Unreal, with your references beside it.

items.name: Garment fit
items.line: A post step of MeshForge Garment. Wraps a garment around your character’s body: a type (thirteen, from T-shirt to helmet), a fit from tight to oversized, and the clearance in centimetres.

items.name: Wardrobe skinning
items.line: A post step of MeshForge Garment. Skins the fitted garment to the character’s skeleton, with bone profiles per garment and sculpting in pose.

items.name: MeshForge Garment for MetaHuman
items.line: Turns one fitted garment into one outfit for every body made with the MetaHuman sliders. Part of MeshForge Garment, at its price.

items.name: MeshForge TRELLIS
items.line: An early preview in Labs. Microsoft TRELLIS.2 on your own graphics card or a rented one, from one picture, free per take, and concept pictures drawn locally with FLUX.2 or SDXL. It needs a lot of graphics memory.

page.promise: An open world from a real place, without the lost weeks.
page.subline: A playbook is production know-how you can follow: a guide for you, skills and scripts for your agent. This one is how we built Colony’s Alpine valleys from real survey data: water that follows the ground, roads that cut and bridge it, forests that fill it, a horizon that holds when you fly. Every trap we paid for, written down.
page.priceLine: Paid, bought once. It is the know-how behind our own world; the tools and kits it uses are sold, or free, on their own.
